rule: Owner requested exactly one fixed numbered batch per outstanding workstream. Do not renumber or inflate completion. Each batch maps to one canonical WORKSTREAMS.json ID. Continue next not-yet-closed batch; if blocked record exact reason and move on, without calling it complete. Tested/implemented/accepted statuses are separate; physical device/deployment acceptance remains required. Concurrent completion of a batch may be credited only from actual evidence. New defects are tracked in canonical register separately, never silently added to this fixed denominator. This queue supersedes project-wide 30 batch scheduling for this owner's continuation; historical map retained.
